steps: Paving is charged per square metre, so the cost scales with area, not with perimeter or side length.
Note that doubling the side would quadruple this cost, since area grows as the square of length.
solutionReasoning.answer: $54; the cost is proportional to the area

steps: A pyramid has one third the volume of the prism with the same base and height: (1/3)(7)²(4).
The factor of one third is what distinguishes a cone or pyramid from the cylinder or prism it sits inside.

referenceExample.prompt: Volume of a cone with radius 3 and height 4?

commonErrors.likelyCause: The one-third factor for a tapering solid was omitted.
commonErrors.remediation: State the formula in words before substituting, and check that the result has three dimensions of length.
